push.title: L 1-3 vs FurtzMucho | You: 8.0 (3rd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
Your 3rd worst match performance of the season, buddskees: an 8.0. A dip, not a slide.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at FurtzMucho's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ Completed passes 30, up from your usual 18. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Here's the trick: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- That 8.0 is your 3rd worst match performance of the season. One game, one lesson.
- finishing needs work from you and BellyTb1. Easy plan: square it when the keeper commits.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- In our wins you average 5 misplaced passes; here it was 8. Repeat after me: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Teach your feet: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.

buddskees, write this on your hand if you have to: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Patience with yourself, please. - Coach Lasso
